name: dev.exit1/exit1-mcp
title: Exit1 Uptime Monitoring
description: Set up uptime monitoring from your editor: create checks, alerts, and query uptime. Can sign you up.

environmentVariables.name: EXIT1_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Exit1 Public API key (ek_live_…), created at https://app.exit1.dev/api-keys. Optional: without it the server offers a create_account tool that signs the user up and connects automatically.

environmentVariables.name: EXIT1_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Exit1 API base URL. Development only.
